# artifactapi Provider

Manage ArtifactAPI local, remote and virtual repositories.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    artifactapi = {
      source = "IUCLabs/artifactapi"
    }
  }
}

provider "artifactapi" {
  endpoint = "https://artifactapi.example.com"
  # token defaults to the ARTIFACTAPI_TOKEN environment variable
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint` (String) The ArtifactAPI server endpoint URL (e.g. https://artifactapi.example.com).

### Optional

- `token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token sent as the Authorization header. Falls back to the ARTIFACTAPI_TOKEN environment variable.
